core_problem_solved: To provide all modules of the ASM bytecode framework (core, commons, tree, etc.) in a single, convenient 'uber-jar' under its legacy Maven coordinate.
key_features: Bundled all ASM modules into a single JAR file to simplify dependency management in older build systems like Ant.
era_and_niche: A convenience artifact for the original ASM distribution, used to simplify the inclusion of the entire framework without needing to manage individual module dependencies.
reason_for_obsolescence: This artifact is **doubly obsolete**. First, its coordinate `asm:asm-all` was superseded when the project moved to the **`org.ow2.asm`** groupId. Second, the 'uber-jar' approach itself is a deprecated practice. The modern approach is to use modular dependencies from the `org.ow2.asm` group (e.g., `org.ow2.asm:asm`, `org.ow2.asm:asm-commons`).
